notes.title: SLIDING HERO SLIDES INTO THE SOKOBAN FEST
notes.notes:
Hello sliders!

Silent Chicken team here.

To celebrate our participation in the STEAM Box-Pushing Fest (so excited!), we are releasing a major Demo update for Sliding Hero.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45014346/934cca6b6b33ecb9357e5c9310f24e3e886f0286.png[/img]

[h2]QOL[/h2]

[h3]Rebinding is now live![/h3]
You can now slide and solve puzzles the way you want: just go over the settings, and choose your own controls!

[h3]No more deadly holes[/h3]
The jumping mechanics were too punitive, so to address the community feedback, we changed the behaviour of the holes in the ground: falling into a hole will now decrease Luca's hearts by one and respawn him right at the room entrance. After depleting all the hearts, Luca will respawn at the latest safe area.

[h3]New tutorial puzzles[/h3]
To improve the demo pacing and better explain certain game mechanics, we added a bunch of mildly challenging puzzles at the start, before reaching the hedge maze area.

[h3]New artworks[/h3]
The bestiary artworks have been updated to the final version.

[h2]BUG Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Localization[/h3]
We solved several bugs related to the Korean, Japanese, and Chinese translations, which prevented specific characters from being shown.

[h3]Prompts[/h3]
Solved an issue not displaying the correct prompts depending on the device connected. Now fully support Xbox, Ps3, Ps4 and Ps5 controllers.

[h2]DISCLAIMER[/h2]

Because of the new rooms, some previous save states may not be working correctly.

Thanks a lot, and keep on sliding!

notes.title: Sliding Hero slides into February Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45014346/28deabe77128d03ce0971fabdb22377828b307f7.jpg[/img]

Hello, sliders! This is the Silent Chicken team. 🐔

We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Sliding Hero will be part of Steam Next Fest this February[/b]! 🎉 That means a brand-new chance to dive into our [b]enhanced demo[/b], featuring refined mechanics, new challenges, and even more secrets to uncover.

If you haven’t met Luca Sicomoro yet, this is your opportunity to step into his boots—a military man of the Serenissima trapped in a mysterious 1700s Venetian villa. With every slide, you’ll encounter [b]devious puzzles, deadly traps, and eerie figures[/b], all while unraveling the mystery behind your imprisonment.

[b]This new demo is our most polished version yet, and we can't wait for you to try it![/b] Whether you're a puzzle master, a Metroidvania explorer, or just love a good mystery, Sliding Hero has something for you.

[b]Will you outsmart the villa’s many trials and unmask the truth? Be sure to play the free demo during Steam Next Fest![/b]

We’d love to hear your thoughts! Share your feedback on our Steam community page or join our Discord to chat with us and other players. Your impressions help us shape the best experience possible!

🔸 Join the discussion on Steam! https://steamcommunity.com/app/2966300/discussions/

🔸 Hop into our Discord! https://discord.gg/F8qkNNEuVj


Thank you for your support—we can’t wait to hear what you think, and keep on sliding! ❤️

notes.title: Sliding Hero in Games in Italy!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45014346/0f22b0e2481e256f35fb48f33e2f72945cc2e65f.png[/img]

[b]Hello, sliders! This is the Silent Chicken team.[/b] 🐔

We have an announcement that fills us with joy: [b]Sliding Hero[/b] will be participating in the [b]“Games In Italy”[/b] event on Steam, from [b]November 21 to 25![/b] 🎉 An event organized by [b]IIDEA[/b] to celebrate Italian video games, and we are thrilled to be there alongside so many amazing colleagues.

Sliding Hero is our great little journey into a mysterious Venetian villa from the 1700s, where every slip of the protagonist, Luca, is a puzzle to be solved. Between retro pixel art, settings and characters inspired by the Venice Carnival, challenging puzzles and strategic combat, we like to think we have created something special, a game that mixes challenge and wonder.

If you haven't yet met Luca and the other inhabitants of this strange villa, this is your chance to exòplore it, avoid traps, and be swept away by the unique charm of our world.

But don't stop there! “Games In Italy” is also an opportunity to discover many other Italian gems: whether you're a fan of RPGs, creative indies, or looking for something cozy, we're sure you'll find the right game that will make you fall in love.

[b]A huge thank you[/b] to those who have already supported us and to those who will discover us for the first time. We look forward to hearing what you think of Sliding Hero!

👉 [b]Find out more about the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/GamesinItaly2024]Games In Italy[/url][/b] event.

notes.title: SLIDING HERO IS PART OF THE CONVERGENCE SHOWCASE!
notes.notes:
We slid it again, and are part of a new showcase, side by side with some exciting new games and announcements.

Discover more about the game at 9 PM GMT +1 [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abLORQCxCzo]here[/url] and check out the selection [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45098973/sale/convergence-games-showcase-2024]here[/url].

We are out with Sliding Hero’s biggest demo update to celebrate the occasion!

[h2]Explore a new section of the gardens[/h2]

A previously locked area of the garden is now mysteriously open. Where will it lead? Which challenges will it hide? What mysteries? Find it out now.

[h2]Sliding Hero goes polyglot![/h2]

Enjoy the tale of Luca Sicomoro in a selection of languages as part of the idioms update series. All the dialogues and menu entries are now translated, and the UI will be tackled next.

[h2]How fast can you slide?[/h2]

Upon finishing the demo, you can now discover your performance: the number of moves, time to finish the demo, number of deaths, and so on. Can you beat the record?

Let us know what you think of the new Demo in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2966300]Steam Community[/url], and share your stats!
